howto.name: Upload your PDF
howto.text: Select one or more PDFs, up to 500 MB each. The PDF needs real text: a scanned page has no words to search.

howto.name: Let it find the addresses
howto.text: There is nothing to draw or type. PrivaTools reads the text of every page and picks out each web address that starts with http:// or https://. Addresses without that prefix, such as www.example.com, and email addresses stay plain text.

howto.name: Download the linked PDF
howto.text: Click Add hyperlinks. Each address found gets a clickable link over its text that opens the address when clicked in a PDF reader.

faq.q: Can I link to other pages in the same PDF?
faq.a: No. It only links web addresses already written in the text. For jumps to pages within the document, add bookmarks with the Bookmarks tool.

faq.q: Are the links visible to the user?
faq.a: The clickable area is invisible and sits over the address text, which looks as it did before. To make links stand out, draw an underline with Edit PDF.

faq.q: Will hyperlinks survive printing or PDF/A conversion?
faq.a: A link has no printed appearance, so paper copies show only the address text. PrivaTools' PDF to PDF/A keeps the links: it re-saves the file with a PDF/A-2b label and does not remove annotations.
